name: WIAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Wisconsin Rapids, WI · The Ridges Golf Course
headline: WIAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Stevens Point won its fifth straight Division 1 boys title with 90 points, ahead of Menomonee Falls, and Milwaukee King's Logan Zeise won the race in 15:02. Neenah took its third straight Division 1 girls title, edging Mount Horeb by 2 points, and Bloomer's Aliyah Hartman set a state-meet record with a 17:01 win. Campbellsport (102) and New Berlin Eisenhower (87) won the Division 2 team titles, and Marathon (102) and Southwestern (112) won in Division 3, where Three Lakes/Phelps' Nolan Waltz (15:58) and Southwestern's Mackenzie Knuckey (18:49) won the individual races.
